tips.tip_test_mic:
Microphone Test.
Click the play button below and say a few words.
tips.tip_get_a_place: Find a quiet place to take the test so external noise does not affect your recording.
tips.tip_only_the_student: Only the student should read the words during the recording. If someone is helping the student, it is important to remain silent to avoid interfering with the result.
tips.tip_tour: If you have questions about how to proceed with the exam, use the help button in the bottom right corner of the screen.
